name: teamsync
description: TeamSync — Smart Team Collaboration and Project Management Platform (MERN)

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,magenta "npm run demo --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
